title: Denial Brings you Closer to Submission
description:
This file is part of my Locktober Series, specifically Week Two, and it pairs with this week’s writing task :

“Denial is good for me. Denial brings me closer to submission.”

For a little extra brainwashing, put this on loop while you write your lines for me.

This is a loopable brainwashing track filled with layered moans, kisses, whispers and subliminal messages while I convince you that denial makes you feel more submissive, and of course, that’s very good for you. To make it all even better, I’ll be using your “Melt For Me” trigger.

No orgasms. No touching. No edging.

Only denial.

Only submission. As always, this file is an erotic hypnosis fantasy and is best enjoyed with an understanding of subject agency. For more information on subject agency, MuttHypno has an excellent and comprehensive writing on Building Subject Agency
author: Lambellina
